title: 洋食・カフェのメニュー料理
subject_en: Western-style Japanese cafe and diner dishes, each ONE dish on its plate or in its bowl centred in its cell, seen from a slightly raised front angle. Flat vector style with clean shapes, bright natural colours and simple highlights. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (plates, paper, white fur, steam) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: オムライス・ハンバーグ・パスタ・パンケーキなど、洋食店やカフェのメニューに並ぶ料理を、フラットなタッチで描いた12点です。メニュー表や店の案内、チラシに使えます。
items: an omelette rice with a yellow omelette and red sauce on an oval plate, with a spoon
a hamburg steak with brown sauce, carrots and green beans on a round plate
spaghetti napolitan, orange-red noodles with sliced sausage and green pepper on a plate with a fork
curry and rice on an oval plate with brown curry, white rice and a small pickle, a spoon beside
a round pizza with one slice pulled away, melted cheese, tomato and basil leaves
a baked gratin in a white oval dish with a golden brown cheese top and steam
a bowl of white cream stew with carrots, potatoes and broccoli, a slice of bread beside
a toasted club sandwich cut in halves with lettuce, tomato and ham, held with picks, a few fries
a grilled steak with a sauce, corn and potato on a hot plate
three fried shrimp with golden crust, a lemon wedge and shredded cabbage
a stack of three fluffy pancakes with a square of butter and syrup dripping
a tall parfait glass with ice cream, fruit, whipped cream and a wafer
